description: Domino's Pizza, Inc. is the largest pizza company in the world with more than 22,100 locations in over 90 markets around the world as of December 28, 2025, operating two distinct service models within its stores with a significant business in both delivery and carryout. It is a highly recognized global brand focused on value while serving neighborhoods locally through its large worldwide network of franchise owners and U.S. company-owned stores, and it has been selling quality, affordable food since 1960, becoming Domino's Pizza in 1965 and opening its first franchised store in 1967, and over the past 65 years it has built Domino's into one of the most widely recognized consumer brands in the world. It is primarily a franchisor, with approximately 99 percent of its global stores owned and operated by independent franchisees as of December 28, 2025.
